ga4Id.title: Google Analytics 4 measurement ID
ga4Id.description: Looks like G-XXXXXXX. Loads only after the visitor agrees to analytics.

adsId.title: Google Ads ID
adsId.description: Looks like AW-XXXXXXXXX. Loads after the visitor agrees to marketing. Set conversions in Conversion actions.

gtmId.title: Google Tag Manager container ID
gtmId.description: Looks like GTM-XXXXXXX. Loads after the visitor agrees to analytics or marketing.

ga4ViaGtm.title: Google Analytics 4 runs inside Tag Manager
ga4ViaGtm.description: On: your Tag Manager container loads Google Analytics, so events are counted once. Needs the container id.
